title: Nir
description: A whole package lowered to NIR.

oneOf.description: A struct, class or enum variant constructor.
A prelude function or function block.

si.description: Exact value in base SI units, when the quantity is a constant.

oneOf.description: Name from the standard library, a dependency or a device description.
A state of a state machine (in `verify`).

target.description: Item id when the field names a module item, `state:Fsm.State` for states.

Item.description: A top-level item (or a method of a class).

oneOf.description: Integer. `text` as written, `v` exact decimal value.
Real. `text` as written, `v` exact decimal value.
String, with quotes and escapes as written.
IPv4 address in dotted-decimal form (`192.168.0.10`, spec 02 §2.8).
`set x when c` / `reset x when c`.

on_timeout.description: Step to jump to on timeout.

count.description: Static number of iterations, when known.

Transition.description: `-> Target when cond or after D`.

oneOf.description: External vocabulary that is not typed yet.

kind.description:
`u8` ... `i64`, `index`, `f32`, `f64`, `fixed<I, F>`, `ufixed<I, F>`,
`duration`, or `integer` / `real` for literals without context.

oneOf.description: A type used as a value.
A package module used as a value.

TypeExpr.description: A type as written in the source.

dim.description:
Exponents of the base dimensions in the order
`s m kg A K mol cd rad count`.

offset.description: Exact offset to the base unit (non-zero only for `degC` and `degF`).

scale.description: Exact factor to the base unit, as a decimal or `n/d` string.

text.description: Display text (`mm/s`, or the dimension name for derived units).

UnitFactor.description: One factor of a unit expression.

factors.description: Factors in source order with exponents (division gives negative exponents).

id.description: Stable id (item id, local id `l3`, or field id).
